**Script / Voiceover:**
"In a forest of climbers, Bao Bao felt left behind. Every other panda reached the highest bamboo with ease. But one day, after a clumsy stumble, something happened. He didn't just fall—he rolled. And in that roll, he found a speed no climber could ever match. Bao Bao realized his path wasn't up... it was forward."
